judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are NCERT Learning Outcomes coded LO9 resolved to the same coordinate Class X (rank 1) under the same 'Class X' parent, so no rank difference can supply developmental direction. Their texts do differ substantively (first: SI units, symbols of elements, formulae of simple compounds, chemical equations; second: balanced chemical equations with symbols and physical states, sign convention in optics, SI units), which superficially suggests a deepening from first to second. However, both endpoints carry the 'same_code_different_content' audit flag, and the first endpoint's merge reason explicitly records the runtime anomaly that this Class X Chapter 10 LO9 occurrence carries Class IX LO9 wording, with finalization deferred to manual review. The pair may therefore represent one class-level LO's variant/mis-located extractions rather than two distinct Class X learning targets, and the very placement that would ground same-rank or cross-class direction is the item under dispute. Source evidence for both endpoints is also truncated (32 and 44 omitted evidence items), so the anomaly cannot be resolved from the bounded evidence. The evidence is materially ambiguous, so no edge is proposed.
